refreshNote: Refreshed after the 2026-08-09 stance-parity write (five VMAD Stance_* Int properties on Mara, Stendarr, Y'ffre and Boethiah). Size is unchanged from the 2026-08-08 proof at 649,917 bytes, which is the expected shape for in-place Int edits; a size change would have been the silent-revert tell.

recordSummary.frameNote: Records Devotion.esp DEFINES (origin FormID), as counted by housecarl_cross_plugin_query with plugins=[Devotion.esp] defined_in=true. This is the frame the 2026-08-08 proof used.

fileRecordSummary.frameNote: Every record the FILE contains, definitions plus overrides, as counted by housecarl_read_plugin_file on the absolute path. The 33-record gap against the definedIn frame is exactly the contested override set below (14 Spell + 15 Message + 2 Quest + 2 Cell), and the 22nd type is Cell, which Devotion.esp only ever overrides. The two frames are both correct; do not re-derive this as drift.

contestedRecordBreakdown.note: Enumerated live via housecarl_cross_plugin_query plugins=[Devotion.esp] conflicts_only=true. Devotion.esp is the load-order winner for 31 of the 33; the two CELL records are won by other mods and are covered by cellNestedReferenceRetention below.

details: Devotion.esp carries zero nested placed references under its WindhelmTempleofTalos override, so the later Lux parent winner has no Devotion child set to suppress.
Devotion.esp carries 51 placed-object records under its QASmoke authoring group; direct load-order enumeration resolves all 51 records to Devotion.esp despite the later QASmoke parent winner.

vmadValidation.boundary: Re-derived 2026-08-09 against the live MO2 source tree (100 .psc / 100 classes). The verdict recorded here is the audit's EXIT CODE, not a grepped field. The 2026-07-26 unboundAutoProperties / boundButNullProperties / unverifiableAttachments counts have been RETIRED rather than carried forward a third time: pdv_vmad_audit.mjs now owns that question and reports the unbound set as waived hypotheses, so the old raw counts no longer describe anything this proof checks.

assetWinners.note: Re-derived via housecarl_asset_status against the Devotion Dev profile; every path resolves loose with Devotion as the sole provider.

open: intentional-versus-defective review of the waived unbound Auto properties

refreshProcedure.note: There is no refresh tool. pdv_package_release.mjs only READS this file; it never writes it. Refresh by hand with these calls, in this order, against the Devotion Dev profile.
steps: housecarl_load_order_status lookup='Devotion.esp' -- confirm the Anvil instance and the Devotion Dev profile before anything below becomes a claim
Get-FileHash on the live ESP -> espSha256, espSizeBytes, espModifiedUtc
housecarl_read_plugin_file on the absolute ESP path -> fileRecordSummary and masters
housecarl_cross_plugin_query plugins=[Devotion.esp] conflicts_only=true -> contestedRecordCount and its breakdown
housecarl_read_record 00C325:Devotion.esp fields=VirtualMachineAdapter.* -> the ManagerQuest critical-winner block
housecarl_cross_plugin_query plugins=[Devotion.esp] defined_in=true type=PlacedObject group_by=winner -> cellNestedReferenceRetention
node tools/pdv_vmad_audit.mjs -> vmadValidation (record the exit code)
housecarl_asset_status on the font and urn paths -> assetWinners
refreshProcedure.gateCaveat: pdv_package_release.mjs hardcodes contestedRecordCount === 33. That is PINNING, not verifying: it cannot tell a correct 33 from a coincidental one, and any legitimate future override would fail the gate rather than be re-proved. Tracked separately; do not treat a green run as evidence the contested set was re-derived.
